## Ctrl+R Recent, colorful icons, quieter render budget, terminal basics

Builds on **0.1.29**. User-requested Malgel polish for v0.1.30.

### Open Recent
- **Ctrl+R / ⌘R** opens the searchable **Open Recent** picker (VS Code–ish), not a silent jump to recent #0.
- `secondary-r` is platform-mapped (Control on Linux/Windows, Command on macOS).

### Colorful icons
- Explorer / Quick Open / tab / activity-bar icons use distinct accents per file type and landmark (no more monochrome mud).
- Folders warm amber; Markdown blue; code green; images pink; Typst/PDF red; config amber; activity bar blue / yellow / magenta / cyan.

### Compile / preview errors
- Failed Typst compiles always surface an in-UI error (never a forever spinner / blank hang).
- Compiler-thread panics are caught, reported as a diagnostic, and the live world is rebuilt so the next edit can recover.

### Render budget
- Soft gate prompts only when estimated raster + image usage is **≥ 150 MiB**.
- Smaller / medium docs auto-render again (no more frequent nags under the old 40 MiB / page-count thresholds).

### Terminal
- Line buffer with proper `\r` rewrite, tab expansion, fixed line height, and `whitespace_nowrap` rows so glyph columns stay aligned with the shell cursor.
- **Copy / Paste** header actions and **Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V** (plus ⌘C / ⌘V on macOS).
- Always-visible `$` line composer for Enter-to-run, plus PTY key-forward when the panel is focused.

### Verify
- Unit tests: render-budget 150 MiB gate, file-icon colour families, terminal `\r` / ANSI.
- Xvfb: Ctrl+R Recent dialog; broken `.typ` error banner (no hang); light + medium Typst under budget; colourful Explorer; Terminal Copy/Paste chrome.
